info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Cheque Processing Review-spec
info.description: This API allows financial institutions and businesses to submit reviews of cheque processing operations. By leveraging this endpoint, users can ensure that cheque transactions undergo necessary evaluations, streamlining the review process. Typical consumers include bank employees and financial analysts who need to assess cheque transaction integrity and compliance. The API facilitates the integration of review mechanisms into banking systems, promoting transparency and efficiency in payment processing.

post.summary: Submit a review for cheque processing.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to submit a review related to the cheque processing of a specific resource identified by its ID. The review can include feedback, ratings, and any other relevant information to improve the cheque processing service.

requestBody.description: This request body allows the client to submit a review for the specified cheque processing operation. It includes all necessary information required for the evaluation and processing of the review related to the payment associated with the specified resource identifier.
